column1: # Heating modes. Hemma: 18 °C in the living room and the study, the bedroom cold. Sova: those two cold, the bedroom 17 °C. Borta: all cold (12 °C).
# Schedule: Borta Wed-Thu 09-15, Sova 19-06 every day, Hemma otherwise. Around each switch both modes count for an hour and the warmer

# wins: a room that gets warmer starts an hour early, a room that gets colder waits an hour. A mode chosen by hand holds until auto; manual (chosen on the page, a target changed in the UI, or a setpoint changed on a thermostat) leaves the targets alone until the schedule's next switch, or until a mode or auto is chosen.
